name: fleet
description: 战舰单数 FLEET — 浏览器原生 Battleship Solitaire. 每个题面的唯一解由两条独立路线对账, 难度是求解器实测的假设栈深 depth, 不是星级.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js server.cjs electron/main.cjs tools/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node tools/playtest.mjs selftest && echo OK
scripts.unit: for f in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run unit

author: z-biz-game
